QuestInfo.name: Lonely Moonie
QuestInfo.0: Go speak to Moonie, who's playing by himself.
QuestInfo.1: Moonie seems awfully lonely. He says the Mercedes used to play the Music Box for him. \r\nMaybe playing a new song in the Music Box will cheer him up. Speak with Astilda.
QuestInfo.2: You want to play Moonie a song. Astilda gives you a magical score and teaches you how to play the Music Box.

0.0: WOWWEE! Maple World sounds super-cool, amazing, awesome, even funner than picking my boogers! I want to go to ALL the places you mentioned!\r\n#L0##bYou don't look that much younger than me. You SHOULD go out and have an adventure!#l\n#k
0.1: I'm too chicken! Bawk, bawk, Moonie. Bawk, bawk. I was kidnapped, and Mercedes saved me, and now I'm scared of everything! \r\n#L0##bHmm, isn't there anything that makes you feel brave?#l\n#k
0.2: Yeah, the Music Box! Mercedes used to play it for me when I woke up with nightmares! \r\n#L0##bAre you talking about this Music Box right here, to our right?#l\n#k
0.3: Yeah! I have a great idea, #h0#! If you play the Music  Box for me, I'll be brave! Can you play me a new song that I've never, ever heard before?

yes.0: You'll need a #bMagical Score#k to play a new song. You can get one from #bAstilda#k, the Elder of Life.

no.0: O-oh. That's okay. You're too busy for me. I understand.
no.1: Mercedes is busy... Philius is busy... Astilda is busy... Danika is busy... #h0# is busy... I guess I'll just sit here and play with dirt.

1.0: Ah, Explorer. I saw you speaking with Moonie. What a sweet child.

yes.0: Here's a Magical Score. Use it on the Music Box, and it will play a song written on your heart. I mean that figuratively.

npc.0: Astilda is the Elder of Life. She's busy doing grown-up stuff with the other leaders, under the big tree at the center of Elluel.
